actions.name: web_search
actions.description: Run a web search through a provider (brave) with the API key resolved from an allowlisted env var; returns up to 20 results. The query text leaves this machine.

query.description: Search query. Required, non-empty, capped at 400 chars.

provider.description: Provider adapter. brave = Brave Search API (GET, X-Subscription-Token); tavily = Tavily Search API (POST, Authorization: Bearer). Defaults to brave.

api_key_env.description: Name under which the search process resolves the key at call time (vault-first, env-var fallback; never a literal key). Must be on the operator's SEARCH_PLUGIN_ALLOWED_KEY_ENVS allowlist. Required.

count.description: Max results to return. Default 5, capped at 20.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout for the underlying HTTP request. Default and cap 30000.

SEARCH_PLUGIN_ALLOWED_KEY_ENVS.description: Required, default-deny: comma-separated, exact-match allowlist of every env var name a caller's api_key_env may reference. Without it every web_search request is rejected.
